concept: Inked Bandra: a hand-illustrated 3D reel. Captions are hard-shadow paper tags, scenes change with an ink wipe.

concept: Stage Night: Prithvi Cafe, Juhu as a theatre curtain-up. Curtain opens on the Bombay Cafe Map logo, a single moving spotlight lights a dark 3D Mumbai map down to the real Prithvi compound, a bulb marquee lights the cafe name, a theatre flip-board rolls to 1978, three dishes sit in pools of light, and the curtain drops on the end card.

dimensions.fonts: condensed grotesk marquee headlines + IBM Plex Mono labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: logo-first inside an opening curtain, then spotlight-follow map zoom from the island shape to the Prithvi compound
dimensions.transition: spotlight hand-off: the light pool moves to the next subject, scenes never cut through black
dimensions.camera: tilt-down descent over the map, slow push-ins on food, hard drop for the end card
dimensions.layout: each scene differs: centred stage, left-weighted marquee, split flip-board, three-beat food row, full-bleed curtain end card
dimensions.texture: velvet curtain, bulb glow, 3D extruded OSM buildings with a detail pass, hand-modelled Prithvi compound
dimensions.sound: curtain rustle, bulb clicks, flip-board clatter, soft pad, slow voice at most 2.2 words per second, no tea pouring
dimensions.ending: curtain drops, stacked Bombay Cafe Map lockup with @bombaycafemap and bombaycafemap.com, Prithvi Cafe at lockup size, held 3 s

concept: Acquisition Lore x The Bakery Price: 'The Paper Trail' explainer. The illustrated Host (poses H00-H04 from the brand guide) walks through a hypothetical bakery's numbers on a deal-desk: receipt slips, a strike-through villain line, thud stamps and orange marker marks. Every animation fires on a word time from the voice engine (data/cues.json), including count-ups, strikes, stamps, pose changes and nods.

dimensions.palette: Acquisition Lore brand guide: Lore Black #0A0A0A, Lore White, Notch Orange #D3743E (one focus per frame), Paper #F3EEE6, Graphite #1E1E1E, Smoke #75747A, Ember #A4501F for small text on paper. Supplied by the brand guide, so locked (the orange + paper pairing is the client's own identity, not Claude branding).
dimensions.fonts: Archivo 900/700 headlines, Instrument Serif Italic accent word, JetBrains Mono labels (brand guide 4.1)
dimensions.opening: hook on black with the illustrated Host pointing, full headline and the big number visible in frame 1 (the cover), marker underline drawn on the spoken number

dimensions.camera: flat desk-top layout, no camera move; Host breathes and nods on keywords

count-up and count-down on spoken numbers
Host pose pop and nod on keywords
dimensions.texture: monochrome film grain on every ground (shifts on twos), torn-edge paper slips with soft shadow
dimensions.sound: word-synced foley (tick, stamp thud, pen scratch, paper slide, tape), minimal warm lo-fi pad and pluck ducked under the voice, Kokoro male voice at word-timed cues
dimensions.ending: close card: full wordmark held over 2 s, Don't start one. Buy one., orange DM LORE box with thud, Host with hand on chest

concept: Marble Top: Kyani & Co., Marine Lines (1904). The camera works top-down over one marble table. A chequered tablecloth wipes between scenes, a ceiling fan spin opens the room, a bun is split and butter melts in, a mawa cake is sliced to show its crumb, handwritten bill lines write themselves in the founder-era ink. Food named, no prices.

concept: Now Playing: Cafe Mondegar, Colaba as a jukebox playlist. Every scene is a record the jukebox picks: a coin drops, the needle lands on the cafe name, a 3D map dive follows a neon route to Colaba Causeway, a record flip carries us into the mural wall, the jukebox selector is pressed on camera, and the end card is the last record spinning to a stop. Equalizer bars driven by the voice and music tie sound to picture.

dimensions.palette: midnight navy #0B1233, chrome white #EEF2F7, signal pink #FF3E8A (no orange, no cream, not aubergine/lime, not ink/marble/red)
dimensions.fonts: one display serif with italic accents + DM Mono labels, two faces only

dimensions.transition: vinyl record flip: a spinning record wipes to the next scene
dimensions.camera: map dive with neon route line, then slow parallax pan across the mural wall, then macro push-in on the jukebox
dimensions.layout: title-strip captions in a slot, centre hero, left-weighted headlines
motion_device: equalizer bars from voice and music
egg drop with wobble and steam

dimensions.sound: coin, needle crackle, button click, plate clink, jazzy bed, voice at most 1.8 words per second
dimensions.ending: record spins to a stop, large Bombay Cafe Map lockup with @bombaycafemap and bombaycafemap.com, Cafe Mondegar as a smaller line, held 3 s

concept: Steel & Steam: Cafe Madras, Matunga East (1940). A kinetic word-stack opens on the cafe name; four different dishes, four different motions (dosa crack, idli dunk and tear, vada press with ripples, sheera scoop), rack focus between plate and steam, no pours; the steel tumbler language (steel plates, katori bowls) ties the scenes together; ends on the large Bombay Cafe Map lockup held 3 s.

dimensions.palette: banana-leaf green #14312A (ground), steel #B5BDC2, jasmine white #F4F6F1, kolam cobalt #4F7DF0 (accent). No orange, no cream, no pink, no red. Not the palettes of Slow Cafe, Mondegar, Kyani or Acquisition Lore.

dimensions.sound: stack thuds, crisp dosa crack, steam, spoon on steel, soft pad; voice at most 1.5 words per second; no pouring
dimensions.ending: green end card, large real Bombay Cafe Map stacked lockup with @bombaycafemap and bombaycafemap.com, 'Cafe Madras, Matunga East, since 1940' as the second large line, held 3 s

concept: Wall Quote: Boojee Cafe, Bandra West. The reel is painted on a white graffiti wall, mirroring the cafe's black-and-white look with quote walls. The name is spray-stencilled in frame 1, a marker line carries the 'luxury, humble beginnings' meaning, three dishes each get a different motion (croissant pull-apart, avocado mash, crepe fold), a seat count-up to 15 anchors the humble start, and the end card is the large Bombay Cafe Map lockup held 3 s.
